summary: Russian Su-34/35 launch maneuvers in Crimea pose KAB guided bomb threat to Odesa region while dual Iskander-M ballistic missile threats emerge from Bryansk and Taganrog. Ukrainian forces struck a Russian base in occupied Kyrylivka eliminating Colonel Mikhail Ivanov, chief of the Main Radio Frequency Center for Zaporizhzhia region. Russian forces advanced near Myrnivka per DeepState map as Shahed-136 drone launches from Kursk (~11 groups) and widespread UAV incursions target northern and eastern regions.
key_points: Russian Su-34/35 aircraft conducted launch maneuvers in Crimea area threatening Odesa region with guided aerial bombs. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69418)
High threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launches detected from Bryansk region and Taganrog, Rostov region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69415, @mon1tor_ua/69417)
Ukrainian strike on Russian base in occupied Kyrylivka eliminated Colonel Mikhail Ivanov, chief of Main Radio Frequency Center for Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @eRadarrua/102883)
Russian forces advanced near Myrnivka according to DeepState map update. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23685)
Shahed-136 strike drone launches from Kursk area observed, approximately 11 groups reported. (Source: @eRadarrua/102904)
Russian tactical aviation active on eastern and southeastern fronts with threat of aviation weapons for frontline areas. (Source: @kpszsu/70367)
KAB strikes reported on eastern Kharkiv region; UAVs targeting Kharkiv from north. (Source: @kpszsu/70368)
Multiple UAV incursions across Sumy, Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, and Kharkiv regions from northern directions. (Source: @kpszsu/70380, @kpszsu/70385, @kpszsu/70403, @kpszsu/70410)

sections.executive_summary: Russian Su-34/35 launch maneuvers in Crimea pose KAB guided bomb threat to Odesa region while dual Iskander-M ballistic missile threats emerge from Bryansk and Taganrog. Ukrainian forces struck a Russian base in occupied Kyrylivka eliminating Colonel Mikhail Ivanov, chief of the Main Radio Frequency Center for Zaporizhzhia region. Russian forces advanced near Myrnivka per DeepState map as Shahed-136 drone launches from Kursk (~11 groups) and widespread UAV incursions target northern and eastern regions.

points: Ukrainian forces conducted a precision strike on a Russian military base in occupied Kyrylivka, Zaporizhzhia region, eliminating Colonel Mikhail Ivanov, 54, chief of the Main Radio Frequency Center for Zaporizhzhia region, who had served over 20 years in the Russian army and directly participated in combat operations since September 2023. (Source: @eRadarrua/102883)
Ukrainian authorities reported a merchant vessel sunk off the Odesa coast after a missile strike, though the responsible party is not specified in the message. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31940)

President Zelensky announced personnel changes in the Ministry of Defense and army command linked to preparation for a difficult winter, emphasizing the need to coordinate key defense structures and energy security. (Source: @UkraineNow/82948)

NABU exposed a criminal group led by former MFA State Secretary Oleksandr Bankov (2020-2024) that embezzled over 37 million hryvnias ($825,000) in international donations intended for Ukraine support, laundering funds through conversion centers. (Source: @UkraineNow/82961)
Former SBU officer Vasily Prozorov claimed Ukraine strikes civilian targets to create tensions among Russian people, per commentary to RT. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31945)
Russian tactical aviation (Su-34/35) conducted launch maneuvers in the Crimea area, posing a guided aerial bomb (KAB) threat to the Odesa region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69418)

High threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launches detected from Bryansk region and separately from Taganrog, Rostov region, indicating potential strikes on Ukrainian territory. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69415, @mon1tor_ua/69417)
Russian forces advanced near Myrnivka in the eastern front, per DeepState map update. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23685)
Russian tactical aviation active on eastern and southeastern operational directions with threat of aviation weapons employment for frontline areas. (Source: @kpszsu/70367)
KAB strikes executed on eastern Kharkiv region; UAVs directed at Kharkiv city from the north. (Source: @kpszsu/70368)
Shahed-136 strike drone launches from Kursk area observed, approximately 11 groups reported, posing threat to Ukrainian territory. (Source: @eRadarrua/102904)

Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmail Baghaei warned Ukraine's attack on a merchant vessel in the Caspian Sea could lead to global war, calling Zelensky's behavior anarchist-like. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31955)
Russian forces advanced near Myrnivka, per DeepState map update, indicating ongoing offensive operations in the area. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23685)
